t.name: Lucas Homestead Trail
t.description: Visit a historic pioneer homestead.Built in the early 1900's from bricks made and fired on site, the Lucas Homestead makes a great educational destination for kids! 2.6 miles round trip. Moderate hike.

t.name: Chelan Butte Trail
t.description: This trail takes you from the Chelan Butte trailhead to the top of Chelan Butte. It’s a challenging hike with a steep incline. It's best to hike on a colder day or start early to avoid the heat as there is no shade.

t.name: Upper Gorge Trails
t.description: The Upper Gorge Trails offer over two miles of single-track trails along the Chelan River.

t.name: Fourth of July Mountain Trail
t.description: This short but steep hike offers 360-degree views of Lake Chelan and the North Cascades.
